bearing_scope: fixed Step3 heads and candidate ground contacts, treated as one massless rigid support
friction_search_scope: try all compact candidates at the existing sufficient witness first; enlarge the friction witness only if that search has no certified result

base.construction: demand hull offset ring minus the object withdrawal shadow

solid.connectivity_rule: One positive outer shell; all negative cavity shells contained; no separate positive or zero-volume shell

trajectory.method: exact convex translation sweep per primitive, replayed on the whole assembly
trajectory.path_definition: support moves +s*D*d on withdrawal; insertion reverses s; object fixed

selection_scope: first certified friction tier, then smallest enumerated certified candidate; unresolved candidates are not proved impossible
